verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for an auth platform, so the axis applies, but no item in the pack names or documents an official SDK. The quickstart tutorials (auth0-docs-103), the "just a few lines of code" marketing (auth0-docs-68), the CLI (auth0-probe-5), the MCP server and Agent Skills are adjacent tooling or vague claims, not documented SDKs. The reviewer's concern is valid: absent explicit SDK evidence, this stays at none.
